about: OrielOS's benchmark set: games with built-in benchmarks, run three times each at fixed settings on the reference PC, on OrielOS and on Windows 11, comparing average FPS and 1% lows. settings applies to every game unless one says otherwise.
settings: 1920 x 1080, full screen, the High preset, upscaling (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) off, frame generation off, V-Sync and frame limits off

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
games.benchmark: Main menu: Settings, then Run benchmark

games.name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider
games.benchmark: Main menu: Options, Graphics, Run benchmark
